blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The latest findings from the 2026 United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) report 1 confirm what Sen. Loren Legarda has long warned against: Global climate targets are falling drastically short, and the Philippines is among the most vulnerable countries. But as Legarda stressed in a recent statement: “We should not remain merely a victim of climate. Though we are among those most affected, we should become an example for the whole world on how to stand, fight, and implement real solutions based on nature and science.” In that statement, Legarda highlighted the following key points of the UNEP report: […]...
